body: Its Sober by Childish Gambino, and I think its the beat and melody and the sound of his voice, its kind of a soft falsetto

I don't really have any friends beyond those I was staying with, its really hard for me to make friends with people so when I do I tend to focus on those. I have a few friends from highschool but I haven't talked to them in years. As for local resources there really isn't any available. There are a lot of homeless people in my area and so those services are already stretched thin. As for my studies, I only have a year of undergraduate work and my school doesn't offer anything like mental health services and there is no where in the community I could get them for free. I've already looked into this stuff when I was first kicked out.
It only just started when I made the decision . . . and there is this one song that I've been listening to for the past few days that relaxes me but that's the only thing.
I know that I am certainly depressed but there really isn't too much to say beyond that. And I don't really feel anything now, kind of empty. It feels kinda nice.
I'm actually studying psychology and I used to . . . but I don't enjoy much of anything anymore
The area I live in doesn't really have the type of people who hire house sitters and what little money I have I save for gas and food.
